answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in falcon, expire in summit, and dawn lists each expiry. Anyone running 131 aliases therefore needs 28 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3449 identities would post 747 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
